emergence.summary: Inborn error of bone mineralization. Loss-of-function of ALPL -- the gene for tissue-nonspecific alkaline phosphatase (TNSALP), the ectoenzyme that dephosphorylates extracellular inorganic pyrophosphate (PPi), pyridoxal-5'-phosphate (PLP) and phosphoethanolamine -- lowers TNSALP throughput, so its substrate PPi ACCUMULATES extracellularly. Because PPi is a potent INHIBITOR of hydroxyapatite crystal growth, the deficient enzyme leaves mineralization over-inhibited: rickets/osteomalacia, premature deciduous tooth loss, and in the perinatal/infantile forms respiratory insufficiency and PLP-dependent (vitamin-B6-responsive) seizures. The disease is read as the TNSALP substrate-dephosphorylation / mineralization-throughput axis driven DOWN (a deficient ectoenzyme whose substrate accumulates -- the same enzyme-deficiency-with-substrate-accumulation shape as the lysosomal storage reads, here on an extracellular mineralization enzyme rather than a lysosomal catabolic one). Correction is to restore enzymatic throughput (replace the enzyme). The kit re-derives the approved replace arm -- asfotase alfa, a bone-targeted recombinant TNSALP-Fc-deca-aspartate enzyme replacement that homes to mineralizing matrix and restores local PPi hydrolysis. This pairs with X-linked hypophosphataemia as the OPPOSITE bone-mineral defect: HPP is an ALPL enzyme DEFICIENCY read on the throughput axis DOWN (replace the enzyme), whereas XLH is a PHEX released-brake read on the FGF23 hormone axis UP (restrain the excess hormone). The gamma read is of the ALPL locus switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesion is coding (e.g. p.Glu191Lys, p.Ala116Thr), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O]. NOTE: high-dose vitamin D / calcium / phosphate are NOT corrective switch levers here (they do not restore TNSALP and can drive hypercalcaemia/nephrocalcinosis), and pyridoxine (B6) addresses only the downstream PLP-seizure consequence -- both are downstream-symptomatic, not switch levers (the XLH/Rett downstream-agent discipline).

per_gene.note: ALPL encodes tissue-nonspecific alkaline phosphatase (TNSALP / liver-bone-kidney isozyme), the GPI-anchored ectoenzyme on osteoblast/chondrocyte membranes and matrix vesicles that hydrolyses extracellular inorganic pyrophosphate (PPi) and pyridoxal-5'-phosphate (PLP). LOF lowers PPi hydrolysis -> PPi (a mineralization inhibitor) accumulates -> defective hydroxyapatite deposition (rickets/osteomalacia, dental disease); PLP accumulation underlies the B6-responsive seizures of severe forms. Located 1p36.12. NCBI official symbol ALPL. Both autosomal recessive (severe perinatal/infantile) and autosomal dominant (milder) inheritance occur via the allele's residual activity and dominant-negative dimerisation. Coding lesions (e.g. p.Glu191Lys, p.Ala116Thr, p.Arg54Cys); promoter firewall respected.
